name: no_schema
lossy: no schema: a scalar is its text, an empty list or map renders as nothing

name: no_schema_item_keys

name: string_for_any_of

name: float_for_integer
lossy: a float under an integer schema stays its text

name: none_in_list
lossy: None inside a list renders an empty item, read back as the empty text

name: ns_in_string
skip: a string holding the NS token renders markup the reader takes apart

name: key_not_a_name
